health_low.description: For health_stat in_range: the bottom of the range, in their unit.

health_metric.description: For 'health': which measurement, by its key, e.g. steps, resting_heart_rate, weight, blood_glucose, active_energy, sleep_stage.

health_stat.description: For 'health': how a day is worked out. Defaults to the metric's own (steps add up, heart rate averages, weight takes the last reading). in_range is the share of the day inside health_low..health_high, as a percentage.

kind.description: For 'new': 'check' for a yes/no habit, 'amount' for a quantity (the default), 'dose' for medication.

max.description: At most this much per period. In the tracker's unit.

measure.description: When there is no tracker_id, what to count: 'time' is minutes of logged time filed under the goal or role; 'finished' is things finished off a shelf (a re-read counts); 'screen' is minutes of screen time from the Screen time app, all of it or narrowed by `screen_category` or `screen_item`; 'health' is a day's figure from the Health app, named by `health_metric` (or written 'health:<metric>'); 'new' makes a tracker recorded by hand, named by `name`.

min.description: At least this much per period. In the tracker's unit.

name.description: For 'new': what is being recorded, e.g. 'TV'.

per.description: The calendar period the target is counted over.

remove.description: Remove the tracker's target for this period instead of setting it.

role_id.description: Or under this role directly. From list_roles.

screen_category.description: For 'screen': only this screen time category, by name, e.g. 'Social'.

screen_item.description: For 'screen': only this app or site, as screen_time names it (app:firefox, site:youtube.com) or by its name or web address.

shelf_id.description: For 'finished': which shelf. From list_shelves. Omit for every shelf.

tracker_id.description: An existing tracker to set a target on. From list_trackers. Omit to make a new one with `measure`.

unit.description: For 'new': the unit, e.g. 'min', 'pages'. Empty for a count.

from.description: First night's date, inclusive. Defaults to 6 days before `to`. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Last night's date, inclusive: a night is filed under the day it ended on. Defaults to today. At most 90 days in all. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: When to bring it back, as a timestamp like 2026-09-15T08:00:00Z.

month.description: The month, as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-09. Defaults to this month.

months.description: Also give income and spending for this many months ending with `month`, oldest first, for a trend. At most 24.

brief.description: What the job should know that it will not otherwise: who is asking and why, what they already know or have ruled out, and what shape of answer would help -- a recommendation, a comparison, a reading list. Nothing else about this conversation reaches the job, so say it here. If there is truly nothing to add, say so in a few words.

question.description: What to find out, in their words where you have them. One question or one topic: the brief is where the context goes.

from.description: Start of the window, inclusive. Defaults to 7 days back. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: End of the window, inclusive. Defaults to today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

from.description: Start of the window, inclusive. Defaults to 30 days back. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: End of the window, inclusive. Defaults to today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

tracker_id.description: From list_trackers. Omit for every tracker.

ids.description: Ids of the files to move to the trash, from find_files. At most 200.

bcc.description: Replaces bcc entirely. Omit to leave it alone.

body_html.description: Replaces the body. Omit to leave it alone.

cc.description: Replaces cc entirely. Omit to leave it alone.

draft_id.description: Id from draft_reply, draft_message or list_accounts.

subject.description: Replaces the subject. Omit to leave it alone.

to.description: Replaces the recipients entirely. Omit to leave them alone.

body.description: Replaces the whole body. Markdown. Omit to leave it alone.

date.description: Re-file under a different day. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

entry_id.description: Id of the entry to change.

tags.description: Replaces the tags entirely. Omit to leave them alone.

title.description: Replaces the title. Omit to leave it alone.

add_attendees.description: Email addresses to invite. Each is emailed an invitation by the calendar's server.

date.description: Move it to this day. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

remove_attendees.description: Email addresses to take off the guest list. They are told.

repeat.description: Make it repeat like this, replacing any rule it had.

count.description: Stop after this many times. Leave out, with until, to repeat indefinitely.

interval.description: Every how many: 2 with weekly is every other week. Defaults to 1.

until.description: The last day it may happen. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

week_of_month.description: Monthly only: 1 to 4, or -1 for the last -- as in 'the second Tuesday' (2, with weekdays [tuesday]). Leave out for the same date every month.

weekdays.description: Weekly: the days it falls on (leave out for the start's own day; monday to friday for every weekday). Monthly with week_of_month: the one day.

scope.description: For a repeating event: occurrence changes only this one, series changes every one. Defaults to occurrence. Changing how it repeats always means series.

start_time.description: New start, as HH:MM in 24-hour time.

stop_repeating.description: Make a repeating event a one-off.

horizon.description: When it would ideally be true by. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

role_id.description: Move it under a different role.

fields.description: The shelf's own fields, by the keys list_shelves gives: an author, a cuisine, an ABV. A list field -- a recipe's or a cocktail's ingredients and method -- takes one entry per line. An empty string clears one.

finished_on.description: The day you finished. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

image_url.description: Replace its cover with this picture: the image_url of a look_up_item or search_images result, or an address they gave you, exactly as written. An empty string removes the cover.

position.description: Where you have got to -- a page, an episode, whatever this shelf counts in. Recording progress on a wishlist item counts as starting it. Also logged, the same way a status change is.

started_on.description: The day you started. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Move it. `done` records that you got through it.

total.description: The finishing line, if you know it, in the same unit.

body.description: Replaces the whole body. Markdown. Omit to leave it alone.

note_id.description: Id of the note to change.

tags.description: Replaces the tags entirely. Omit to leave them alone.

title.description: Replaces the title. Omit to leave it alone.

about.description: A paragraph in their own words about their work, family and what they care about. Replaces whatever is there now.

born.description: Date of birth. Cannot be in the future. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

gender.description: One word, in their own words — there is no fixed list.

location.description: Roughly where they live now, e.g. a city. This is what get_weather reads.

project_id.description: Id of the project to change.

start_date.description: Set the start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

date.description: The corrected day it belongs to. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

value.description: The corrected number. For a yes/no tracker, 1 or 0.

ask_in_chat.description: While it runs, put questions to them in that chat: approvals for anything that deletes or sends, and a question when it needs a fact or a decision only they have. Sends the result there too. False stops asking.

at.description: New time of day as HH:MM.

email_account.description: Which of their mail accounts to email from, by address. Omit for the first one.

email_me.description: Also email the result to them, from one of their mail accounts to its own address. False stops emailing it.

enabled.description: Switch it on or off without deleting it.

instructions.description: Replaces the instructions. Omit to leave them alone.

max_steps.description: The most steps a run may take, 1 to 100 -- each step is one turn of yours, which may call tools. Omit for the assistant's own limit; 0 goes back to it. Only if they ask, or the work plainly needs many reads.

model.description: Which of their models it runs on, as set up in Settings → Models: large for work that needs the most thought, medium (the assistant's own, and the default) for most, small for something quick and simple. Only if they ask.

name.description: Replaces the name. Omit to leave it alone.

send_to_chat.description: Also send the result to them in their chat (Matrix, through the bot they reach you by), as well as keeping it in the app. Only if they have a chat link set up. False stops sending it there.

description.description: Replaces the description. Omit to leave it alone.

instructions.description: Replaces the instructions. Omit to leave them alone.

name.description: Replaces the name. Omit to leave it alone.

assignee.description: Who does it: owner (them; the default) or assistant (you, as a background job when its reminder comes round).

clear_due_time.description: Remove the time of day, keeping the due_date.

clear_project.description: Move it back to the inbox.

clear_purpose.description: Unfile it from whatever goal or role it carries.

due_time.description: Time of day the deadline bites, HH:MM in 24-hour time. Allowed only once the task has a due_date, whether it already had one or this same call is setting one.

goal_id.description: File it under this goal, from list_goals.

remind_date.description: The day of the reminder. Defaults to today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

remind_time.description: Set the reminder to this time, HH:MM in 24-hour time, on remind_date. A time later than the last reminder sends it again.

role_id.description: Or under this role directly, from list_roles.

start_date.description: Set the start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Move it. Use done to complete a task.

task_id.description: Id of the task to change.

date.description: Move it to this day. Omitted, it stays where it is. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: New end, as HH:MM. Must be after the start.

goal_id.description: File it under this goal, from list_goals.

label.description: Or give it this free-text label instead.

role_id.description: Or under this role directly, from list_roles.

start_time.description: New start, as HH:MM. Omitted, it stays where it is.

task_id.description: Move it onto this task instead.

excluded.description: True leaves them out of budgets and totals (a reversed charge, a transfer they do not want counted); false counts them again.

ids.description: Transaction ids, from find_transactions. At most 200.

note.description: The person's note on them. An empty string clears it.

payee.description: The person's own name for the payee, shown instead of the bank's. An empty string goes back to the bank's.

condition.description: Only this condition: its id or name. Omit for all of them.

since.description: Start of the period. Defaults to 90 days before `until`. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: End of the period. Defaults to today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

date.description: The day the note is about -- the day it should be read on. Any day, past or future. Defaults to today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

heading.description: A short heading for this note on the day's page, such as "From the weekly plan". Optional.

text.description: The note, in Markdown, written to yourself: what to raise or check that day, what a plan decided about it, and why.
